title: kcapi PBKDF2-SHA384/SHA512 implementation
description: Add pbkdf2(sha384) and pbkdf2(sha512) to kcapi provider. Kernel has no native PBKDF2 API (confirmed via /proc/crypto). Implement manually using crypto_alloc_shash(hmac(sha384)) + RFC 8018 §5.2 counter iteration — identical approach to existing kcapi HKDF. Add kcapi_pbkdf2_sha384_kdf and kcapi_pbkdf2_sha512_kdf callbacks. Add ops structs with .min_iterations=1000 and .min_salt_len=16 (SP 800-132). Register in kcapi_algo_list[]. Update kcapi_provider.h with extern declarations. ARRAY_SIZE(kcapi_algo_list)-1 already used so num_algos self-updates.
close_reason: kcapi_kdf.c extended with manual PBKDF2 (RFC 8018 §5.2), registered in kcapi_provider.c, exported in kcapi_provider.h
